Work at Wiliot

We're Hiring

×

Join our Team

Wiliot's Physical AI platform gives supply chains continuous, real-time visibility — turning battery-free IoT Pixels into data that helps some of the world's largest CPG and grocery brands, retailers, quick-service restaurants, automotive manufacturers, and postal and parcel networks cut shrink, reduce waste, and always know where their assets are and what condition they're in.

Do you have modest ambitions, like changing the global economy and making a big dent in climate change? If so, Wiliot is likely to capture your imagination. We’re bringing connectivity and intelligence to trillions of things with our revolutionary “Sensing as a Service” platform. This is IoT as it should be - making otherwise non-communicative products fully expressive – like where they are, and the temperature around them. The sustainability impact of this will be vast; did you realize that 40% of food rots along the way and never makes it to the table? This creates 8% of greenhouse gases, twice as much as the entire airline industry.

Because the Wiliot Platform combines our IoT Pixels (postage-stamp-sized compute devices) and the Wiliot Cloud, we are hiring brilliant, passionate, and caring people across a range of disciplines. We are currently in the supply chains of some of the world’s largest companies – including food and pharmaceutical – turning their supply chains into “demand chains.” The way we manufacture, distribute, sell, consume, and recycle products are all touched and transformed by Wiliot.

Our investors reflect our world-changing ambition: they include Amazon, Verizon, NTT DoCoMo, Qualcomm, PepsiCo, and Softbank Vision Fund 2. If you’re intrigued, check out our job postings here.
